thread:
maya: Heads-up — planning to deploy routing change for model-service at 02:00 PST (today). Main goal: route 10% to v2 for latency tests, then ramp. Need quick runbook/rollback sanity check before we go.
kevin: I'm the deploy owner. I'll be on standby for the window.
li: I'll do smoke checks post-canary (latency, error-rate, token-cost). What's the rollback trigger list?
sam: From previous runs, triggers were: 1) 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m, 2) p99 latency > 3s for 5m, 3) model outputs >5% hallucination on eval set. Do we want to add any safety toggles? :thinking_face:
maya: We do. Add immediate feature-flag kill + traffic re-route to v1. Also have a fallback model variant on standby (v1-quant).
kevin: Rollback steps I have in mind: 1) flip ff:MODEL_ROUTING -> roll back all traffic, 2) scale target pods down for v2 (kubectl) to stop KV cache usage, 3) revert any live config changes and restart gateway. Simple and fast.
li: Can you paste the exact commands we should run so oncall doesn't have to improvise?
kevin: Sure — commands:
```
# route all traffic back to v1
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/flags/update -d '{"flag":"MODEL_ROUTING","value":"v1"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# drain v2 pods
kubectl scale deployment model-service-v2 --replicas=0 -n prod
# restart gateway if needed
kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway -n prod
```
sam: Also add an announcement step to #status and to the release page with the rollback reason and time window — customers on dedicated tiers need heads-up.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy task created: deploy/1796000455-model-routing (ETA 02:00 PST).
maya: Quick preflight checklist (please ack): 1) rollback commands validated (kevin) 2) owner on-call present (sam) 3) smoke script ready (li) 4) monitoring alerts baseline set (maya) 5) rollback doc link accessible (everyone)
li: I validated the smoke script against staging earlier — it checks p50/p95/p99, 5xx, and a small eval prompt set. Link: https://redwood.internal/qa/smoke/1796
sam: I'm oncall for the window and reachable on phone. :phone:
kevin: Rollback doc here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-model-routing — I updated the exact curl payloads and who to page.
maya: ok, last question — go/no-go check in 15m before window. For now I mark this thread as preflight. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you confirm your item.
li: :white_check_mark: smoke script ready
sam: :white_check_mark: oncall available
kevin: :white_check_mark: commands validated and permissions confirmed
maya: :white_check_mark: monitoring baselines saved (timestamped snapshot in observability)
maya: Thanks — will do the 15m check-in with any final callouts. If any of the rollback triggers fire during canary, we execute the above rollback steps immediately and escalate to incident channel.
